    • getParameter

      public static String getParameter(String commandText, String name) throws ContentProcessorException
      Return one parameter. This method calculates the full parameter list every time, so if it going to be used more than once, replace it by getParameters();
      Parameters:
      commandText - The full text of the command
      name - The name of the parameters.
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If the parameter doesn't exist.
      See Also:
      • getParameters(java.lang.String)

    • getParameters

      public static HashMap getParameters(String parameterString)
      Returns a HashMap with all the attributes. MultipleAttributes will be a Collection. Attributes without value will have "true" as value.
      Parameters:
      parameterString - The part of the command which is not its name
      Returns:
      The HashMap with all the attributes.
